annotations.title: Cheefe Prieſts.
annotations.text: [1] Heretikes abuſe the ignorant people with theſe naughtie Prieſts of the old Teſtament, to make that name odious, and to diſcredite the Prieſts of Chriſt in the new Teſtament. But for theſe Prieſts, thou maiſt not maruel that they are ſo buſy againſt Chriſt, [2] partly becauſe they were ſuch as were intruded by the ſecular power of the Roman Emperour, and from yere to yere by bribery and frendſhip, not by ſucceſſion according to the Law of Moyſes: partly becauſe the time was now come when the old Prieſthod of Aaron ſhould ceaſe, and the new begin according to the order of Melchiſedec: and for theſe cauſes God ſuffered their former priueleges of wiſedom and iudgement and diſcretion to decay in theſe later vſurpers, and that according to the Prophet ſaying, [3] The Law ſhal periſh from the Prieſt and counſel from the Ancients. [4] But the Prieſthod of the new Teſtament is to continew vnto the end of the world, and hath (as being the principal part of the Church) the aſſiſtance of the Holy Ghoſt for euer promiſed, to teach it al truth: [5]and for Peter the cheefe Prieſt thereof vnder Chriſt, our Sauiour praied, That his faith ſhould not faile: and to the reſt he ſaid, He that heareth you, heareth me.

notes.text: The Priests of the old Testament.
Euseb. Ec. Hist. li. 1 c. 6. ex Iosepho.
The Priesthod of the new Testament.

annotations.title: To ſatisfie the people.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> Pilate ſhould haue ſuffered death, rather then by other mens prouocation or commaundement haue executed an innocent: as a Chriſtian iudge ſhould rather ſuffer al extremitie, then giue ſentence of death againſt a Catholike man for his faith.

annotations.title: Bying ſindon.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> This dutie done to Chriſtes body after his departure, was exceding meritorious, and is therfore by holy write ſo often commended for an example to faithful men, to vſe al honour and deuotion towards the bodies of Saincts and holy perſons.

notes.text: Religious duty toward the bodies of Christ and his Saincts.
